title: It’s quick, compact and makes a perfect perk!  Thank you mini- me coffee maker
text: It’s quick, compact and makes a perfect perk!  Thank you mini- me coffee maker. Love the individual Keurig.  Perfect and easy to use.  Has less counter space and I use every day.  Perfect Perk!  Thanks.

product_metadata.title: Keurig K-Mini Plus Coffee Maker, Single Serve K-Cup Pod & Keurig K-Cup Pod & Ground Coffee Storage Unit
features: Included in the box: Keurig K-mini plus single serve coffee maker with pod storage unit that fits in your brewer and can hold upto 9 K-cup pods
Fast & fresh brewed: Coffee made in minutes
K-CUP POD AND GROUND COFFEE STORAGE: Drawer holds 12 K-Cup pods, small canister holds 12oz of ground coffee or 6 K-Cup pods, large canister holds 16oz of ground coffee or 9 K-Cup pods
PREMIUM GLASS CONTAINERS: Air-tight seal, versatile storage capability
